text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). SLO breaches detected. Paging on-call.
jamie_ops: ack — taking pager, will triage.
sam_oncall: Jumping in. Seeing a sharp 502/504 uptick starting ~2026-03-17T15:07:00Z. Error rate ~8% for generation endpoints in eu-west-1, streaming endpoints mostly impacted.
maria_sre: Noted. Was there a config rollout earlier to lb-eu-01? I have an alert for a router config push at 2026-03-17T14:58:12Z.
sam_oncall: Yes there's a config hash c3a9f2 that touched proxy routing rules. Trying to repro locally. If this is the cause, rollback is likely fastest mitigation.
jamie_ops: If you plan a rollback, coordinate with deploy-bot and call it out for support. Also drafting status copy while you work.
sam_oncall: Executing rollback to previous router commit now. Command:```bash
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/lb-router lb-router=redwood/lb-router:2026-03-16-c2b7
kubectl -n infra rollout status deployment/lb-router --timeout=5m
```
deploy-bot: @sam_oncall rollback started for deployment/lb-router (requested by sam_oncall). Rollout ID: rl-20260317-01.
jamie_ops: Draft status page update (initial):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for generation requests in EU (eu-west-1). Some requests may experience 5xx errors or streaming interruptions. Engineers are actively rolling back a recent load-balancer routing change and monitoring recovery. Impact: ~8% of gen requests in eu-west. Mitigation: rolling back router config; fallback to another region or use non-streaming endpoint may help. Next update in 15 minutes.
```
ellie_prodcomms: Suggested edits: remove definitive words like "outage" & add actionable workaround. Proposed copy: 
"We are investigating increased errors for text generation in EU (eu-west-1). If you rely on streaming, switching to the standard (non-streaming) generate endpoint or routing requests to us-west temporarily will reduce errors. No keys or customer data are impacted. We will post updates as we learn more"
nick_support: Receiving some inbound tickets. Customers asking if API keys or billing are affected — they are not. Please include that line.
maria_sre: Rollback completed. Rollout rl-20260317-01 finished at 2026-03-17T15:18:34Z. Error rate dropping: now ~2.1% and trending down. 95th latency improved from 1.8s -> 1.05s. Still seeing sporadic KV-cache misses causing retries; investigating whether cache TTL/config was impacted by the routing change.
sam_oncall: Thanks. I'll keep watch for 10m. If no regressions, approve publishing initial status. jamie — ready for you to publish the draft with ellie's language + support line.
jamie_ops: Copy ok. ellie_prodcomms, can you give final sign-off?
ellie_prodcomms: Approving initial publish. I'll push the update once we confirm 10m no-regression window.
sam_oncall: Starting 10 minute observation window now (clear by 2026-03-17T15:28:34Z).
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE: Initial update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-eu-gen-errors (ID: inc-20260317-45) — includes impact, mitigation, and suggested workarounds.
jamie_ops: Noted — posting a short customer-facing note in support queue.
nick_support: Thx, posting canned response in Zendesk: "No API keys or billing impact; mitigation in progress — consider routing to us-west or switching to non-streaming endpoint."
maria_sre: Observation window complete — no regression for 12 minutes and metrics stable. KV-cache miss rate back to baseline after rewarm.
sam_oncall: Confirm resolved. Root cause: unintended routing rule in lb-eu-01 introduced during a targeted config change; rollback resolved the symptom. No customer data lost.
jamie_ops: Draft resolved notice: 
```
Resolved — 2026-03-17T15:30Z: Elevated error rates for generation in EU (eu-west-1) have subsided after rolling back a load-balancer routing change. Root cause: unintended routing rule change; mitigation: rollback to previous router config. Impact: ~8% of gen requests experienced errors for ~25 minutes. No data loss; keys and billing unaffected. If you continue to see issues, contact support.
```
ellie_prodcomms: LGTM, will publish resolved notice and close incident on status page.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE: Resolved update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-eu-gen-errors/resolved (ID: inc-20260317-45/resolved)
jamie_ops: Thanks everyone — logging post-incident actions: 1) review router rollout gating and add canary checks, 2) add additional health-check on KV-cache warming phase, 3) follow up with infra on deploy rollback playbook. I'll open the follow-up tickets.
sam_oncall: Closing pager. All good from on-call.
